emulator.name: mGBA
emulator.bundle_provenance: Build GBA GDB Debugger Bundle workflow artifact

experiments.trigger: Boot with the supplied copied 8-KiB save image.

observations.instrumentation_gap: Block 0x1F4 was crossed while reconnecting the RSP client; the surrounding payload-loop sequence was 0x1F3 then 0x1F5.

experiments.conclusion: Runtime confirms the known boot header reads and the payload loop ending at block 0x3EE. This single boot scenario does not prove the tail unused by every subsystem.

experiments.trigger: Continue boot after the copied save failed retail validation.
experiments.conclusion: The invalid-save path attempted repeated writes to the three header blocks only. Exact retry semantics remain bounded by the existing Task 5 analysis.

experiments.trigger: Press Start on the title screen before the main menu appears.

observations.screen_after_return: Main menu with NEW GAME selected

experiments.conclusion: 0x08064E10 participates in main-menu initialization or rendering. Selecting NEW GAME did not call it again, so it is not the final creator interception site.

experiments.trigger: Select NEW GAME and advance through the initial bedroom dialogue.
experiments.conclusion: The opening dialogue's Tyson text does not pass through the candidate protagonist lookup during the observed segment. The Enter name descriptor is not part of the initial New Game sequence.
